english.note: Choose this when stressing practical reality rather than simply correcting or qualifying what was said.
Choose this when contrasting the actual situation with what is official, theoretical, or technically correct.

examples.english: In practical terms, this plan effectively doesn’t help us save money.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃實際上幫唔到我哋慳錢。
